result.summary: The screen exhibits minor layout and state inconsistencies, notably clipped card content at the bottom and active category filter mismatches.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is partially cut off behind the bottom navigation bar, hiding its title and metadata.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom scroll padding so the last list item can be scrolled fully into view above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is active, but the displayed restaurants feature non-pizza items like Poké, Burgers, and Ramen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure content list updates dynamically to reflect the selected category filter.

issues.description: The third item title in the horizontal carousel 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated abruptly at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel card width or horizontal peek margin to avoid awkward text clipping.
